description: This Java class 'SecretFromPathReader' creates a Secret object from a file specified by a Path. It reads the file content to generate the Secret, using the file name as the secret name. It provides static factory methods for instantiation and handles IO and state exceptions during reading.

classes.name: SecretFromPathReader
classes.description: A final class implementing Supplier<Optional<Secret>> that reads a secret from a file path.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance from a Path, extracting the file name as secret name.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance from a secret name and a Path.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an Optional<Secret> by attempting to read the secret from the file path.

methods.name: tryToReadSecretFromPath
methods.description: Private method that reads the secret, handling IO and state exceptions, returning null on failure.

methods.name: readSecretFromPath
methods.description: Reads all lines from the file; if empty, throws an exception; otherwise creates a Secret with the first line.
